content:
{
  "summary": "Bot cuts off calls abruptly without proper close or confirmation, and logs enriched leads when buyers reject products or provide contradictory info.",
  "fixes": [
    {
      "title": "Always read back requirement before closing",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot closes calls without confirming the buyer's requirement, leading to unverified leads or abrupt disconnections.",
      "prompt_section": "Conversation Closing Rules",
      "current_instruction": "Before ending, set the correct @ buyer_disposition and @ call_outcome . Closing responses are statements, never questions, and never invite further discussion.",
      "suggested_text": "Before ending, read back the confirmed requirement and key details, ask for final confirmation, then set @ buyer_disposition and @ call_outcome and invoke end_interaction with a clear closing statement.",
      "why_it_helps": "Ensures requirement read-back before close, preventing unverified leads and abrupt disconnections.",
      "calls_affected": 5,
      "fatal_codes": ["F2", "F4"],
      "example_call_ids": ["90853053", "91046432", "91063611", "91156546", "91264775"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Stop collection when buyer rejects product",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot proceeds to collect details after buyer clearly rejects the product, logging an enriched lead without genuine intent.",
      "prompt_section": "Intent Handling — General",
      "current_instruction": "A single reply may carry multiple intents (max 2 in @ turn_intent ). Address the immediate concern, then continue the next eligible collection step.",
      "suggested_text": "If the buyer clearly rejects the product or states no interest, stop collection immediately, set @ buyer_disposition to 'BL Deleted', @ call_outcome to 'No Product Requirement', and invoke end_interaction with a polite close.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents logging enriched leads when buyer has no genuine requirement, reducing false positives.",
      "calls_affected": 2,
      "fatal_codes": ["F2"],
      "example_call_ids": ["91100801", "91264775"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Handle payment objection before closing",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot closes without addressing buyer's payment objection, causing call drop with unresolved concern.",
      "prompt_section": "Intent Handling — General",
      "current_instruction": "A single reply may carry multiple intents (max 2 in @ turn_intent ). Address the immediate concern, then continue the next eligible collection step.",
      "suggested_text": "If buyer raises a payment objection, acknowledge it, explain seller can discuss payment terms, and only close after resolving or deferring. Never close mid-objection.",
      "why_it_helps": "Resolves buyer concerns before close, preventing abrupt disconnections during objections.",
      "calls_affected": 2,
      "fatal_codes": ["F6"],
      "example_call_ids": ["91100938", "91156726"]
    },
    {
      "title": "Never end call mid-sentence or mid-question",
      "what_goes_wrong": "Bot cuts off mid-sentence or mid-question, leaving buyer hanging and causing technical drops.",
      "prompt_section": "Conversation Closing Rules",
      "current_instruction": "Every closing path must invoke end_interaction. Never end a call without invoking end_interaction.",
      "suggested_text": "Never end a call mid-sentence, mid-question, or while the buyer is still speaking. Always complete the sentence and then invoke end_interaction.",
      "why_it_helps": "Prevents abrupt technical drops and ensures proper call termination.",
      "calls_affected": 8,
      "fatal_codes": ["F4", "F6"],
      "example_call_ids": ["91229281", "90643029", "91229392", "91156758", "91046432", "91063611", "91156546", "91264940"]
    }
  ],
  "not_prompt_issues": [
    "Some abrupt disconnections due to telephony/network issues (e.g., CALL 90643030, CALL 91100931)",
    "Buyer hanging up mid-sentence (e.g., CALL 91264775, CALL 91046471)",
    "Call dropped before bot could start (e.g., CALL 90643031, CALL 91046448)"
  ]
}
